entities.name: Islet amyloid polypeptide
observations: The 91-residue query is an exact sequence match to reviewed Octodon degus IAPP/ amylin UniProt P22889; alignment identity and coverage are 100%.
IAPP is a secreted glucoregulatory peptide hormone that regulates energy homeostasis and signals through CALCR-RAMP amylin receptor complexes.
Reported functions include receptor-ligand activity, amylin receptor signaling, positive regulation of calcium-mediated signaling, and positive regulation of cAMP/PKA signaling.
The query contains the Calc_CGRP_IAPP Pfam domain (PF00214.25), residues 27–76, with i-Evalue 1.1e-15.
The N-terminal hydrophobic segment is consistent with a secretory signal peptide; the mature peptide is expected to be processed from a precursor and extracellularly released.
